title: AverageDynISF for Bolus Calculator to follow Profile Switch % - strength ?
symptom: In AndroidAPS 3.3, when Dynamic Sensitivity is enabled, the Bolus Calculator uses an average DynISF value from the last 24 hours instead of the profile ISF. This average is not adjusted when a profile switch to a different percentage (e.g., 80% or 120%) is set, potentially making the ISF too weak or strong for the situation.
cause: The thread discusses whether the average DynISF should be modified by profile switch percentage. Participants note that DynISF is based on TDD and BG and adapts over time, so adjusting it by profile % might double the effect if the profile stays changed for a long time. The issue is closed without a definitive root cause identified.
fix: No fix was implemented; the issue was closed with the decision to start as is (without adjusting the average DynISF by profile percentage).
evidence_quote: I'm closing this now and I agree it's best to start like it is now.
